sentences.en: Excitement over the new product spread quickly throughout the division.
sentences.zh: 新产品带来的兴奋很快就在整个部门蔓延开来。

sentences.en: After the war, the idea of democracy spread throughout Japan.
sentences.zh: 战后，民主思想在日本各地传播开来。

sentences.en: Heat was spread throughout the room by the electric stove.
sentences.zh: 电炉均匀地将热量散布在整个房间内。
